notify_on: Any centralized exchange (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, KuCoin, MEXC, Gate.io, Bitget, Upbit, etc.) announcing a FRINK/FRNK/Frinkcoin spot or futures listing
A confirmed new DEX pool for a FRINK-named token on a new chain
The Frink Coin presale token completing its planned DEX listing
do_not_notify_on: Aggregator pages merely restating the unverified Kraken/Figure/BYDFi venue claims
Price movement with no listing event
Presale marketing or 'top memecoin' listicles with no listing event

CRITICAL FALSE POSITIVE: exchange 'price pages' (coinbase.com/price/..., bitget.com/price/..., binance.com/price/...). These exist for thousands of assets the exchange does NOT list for trading and are auto-generated. A price page is NEVER evidence of a listing. Only a dated announcement from the exchange's own newsroom/announcements feed counts.

Inflated market-cap figures on aggregator pages (e.g. Bitget showing FRNK at $0.006804 / $142.89M mcap) that contradict $0 24h volume elsewhere. Market cap = price x supply and is meaningless without liquidity; a dead token can show a large mcap. Not a listing signal.
baseline_notes: 2026-09-02 12:48Z check: no listing. Added a ninth FRINK-named asset (Solana 4onqpWnV..., launched Jan 2024). Pattern after ~3 days of checks: no listing pipeline for any FRINK asset, but a steady stream of previously-unknown same-name contracts - the name is heavily reused.
data_quality_warnings: Bitget reports FRNK at $0.006804 with a $142.89M market cap while CoinMarketCap/CoinCarp report the token untracked with $0 volume. The Bitget figure is almost certainly price x total supply on a token with no real market. Do not treat it as a valuation.

Bitget's web3 swap page for FRNK (web3.bitget.com/en/swap/bnb/0xf938c9A2...) labels the chain as BNB while using the ETHEREUM contract address. Aggregators mismatch chain and contract for this ticker - another reason to verify on a block explorer rather than trusting aggregator pages.
